summary: China Automotive Systems, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 22, 2026, furnishing a press release of its Q4 and full-year 2025 financial results. The filing reports record earnings per share and net sales, with net sales up 17.6% year-over-year to $765.7 million and diluted EPS rising 43.4% to $1.42. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is announced. The filing is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer, not triggering any special-situation category.
